gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: This file was automatically generated by EvoSuite Sat Jun 13 17:41:43 GMT 2026
ADDED i2: toString() renders options that only have a long name using the long-option prefix ("--"). Here both options lack a short name, so both appear as "--name".
ADDED i3: toString() appends the option description (separated by a space) when the description is non-null, even when it is the empty string.
ADDED i4: toString() renders options that have a short name using the short-option prefix ("-").
ADDED i5: setSelected() throws once a different option has already been selected, because the options in a group are mutually exclusive.
ADDED i7: Re-selecting the same option is allowed and does not throw. The option's value separator remains at its default (the NUL character).
ADDED i8: Selecting a null option resets the selection and leaves the group un-required.
ADDED i9: isSelected() returns true after an option has been selected.
ADDED i10: isSelected() returns false for a freshly created group.
ADDED i11: getNames() returns a non-null collection (empty for a new group).
ADDED i12: setRequired(false) keeps the group un-required.
ADDED i13: isRequired() defaults to false for a freshly created group.
